## §Scope boundary

**Root paths explored:**
- `services/state-worker/` — M1 sole service; charter names `state-worker` exclusively; all Alembic, schema, transitions, sweeps, and §9.1 REST land here.
- `tests/test_state_worker_health.py` — reverse caller of `app.main`; M0 `/health` contract must remain compatible through M1.
- `bishop_shared/constants.py` — forward import from state-worker; sqlite volume mount path `/app/data/sqlite` must align with DB file location chosen in M1.
- `bishop_spec_0_6.md` — normative binding for §6–§7, §8.1, §9.1, §14 (adjacent), §20 (adjacent); read-only reference, not modified by M1.

**Forward import graph (depth 2 from `services/state-worker/app/main.py`):**
- Depth 1: `app.models.HealthResponse`, `bishop_shared.constants.STATE_WORKER_INTERNAL_PORT`, `fastapi`, `uvicorn` (runtime).
- Depth 2: `pydantic`, `bishop_shared.constants` (dataclasses/stdlib only beyond package boundary).

**Reverse import graph (depth 1 callers):**
- `tests/test_state_worker_health.py` → `app.main`, `app.models`, `bishop_shared.constants`.

**Explicit exclusions:**
- `services/scraper/`, `services/pre-filter-worker/`, `services/content-scraper/`, `services/enrichment-batcher/`, `services/batch-poller/`, `services/vector-writer/`, `services/query-api/`, `services/ui/` — charter M1 non-goals; stubs remain unchanged except possible compose image-tag bumps.
- `bishop_spec_0_6.md` §10+ (adapters), §11–§13 (NL profile, pre-filter, enrichment), §16–§18 (query, UI full, backfill) — out of M1 implementation scope; spec prose consumed only where §9.1 endpoints require forward-compatible shapes.
- `.dev/architecture/` — not present at HEAD; charter §7 deferred post-M0; orch must treat as missing handoff input (see §Ambiguity flags).
- `node_modules/`, `.venv/`, `.pytest_cache/`, `bishop.egg-info/` — tooling artifacts.
- All §23 and §24 items per charter.

**File count in scope:** 22 (existing + anticipated M1 deliverable paths listed in §File map)
**Visited-set size (Phase 1 traversal):** 14 unique paths enumerated (4 existing state-worker files, 2 bishop_shared, 1 health test, 1 compose, 1 pyproject, 1 spec, 3 M0 decision logs, 1 docker-compose)
